desc:
🏈 The Come Up: College Football | PUBLIC BETA

Build your player. Earn your spot. Win your matchup. Real football on Roblox, from the trenches to the end zone.

💪 IN THE TRENCHES:
Grapple blocks, bull rushes, block sheds, and double teams. Win your rep or get put on your back.

🧬 YOUR PLAYER:
35 attributes. Height, weight, and position all change how you play. Gear up and wear it on game day.

🏟️ GAME DAY:
Custom playbooks, audibles, captains, auto ref, live stats, and instant replays under the lights.

🎮 WAYS TO PLAY:
League games for your team, or public pickup: race for captain, draft your squad, first to 7.

📱 PC / Console / Mobile Support

🚧 Expect bugs and changes. Send feedback in the community server.
👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite to help the game grow!
